card.text: Dwarf planet with a vast, heart-shaped plain.

introduction.text: New Horizons found mountains of water ice and glaciers of nitrogen ice on Pluto.

surface.title: MVIC color mosaic
surface.summary: Color images cover part of the surface, with detail varying by region.

topography.title: Stereo elevation map
topography.summary: Heights from −8 to +8 km, with shading to show slopes.

monochrome.title: LORRI/MVIC mosaic
monochrome.summary: LORRI and MVIC images, with detail varying across the surface.

methane-ice.title: LEISA methane ice
methane-ice.summary: Methane-rich ice is widespread in the northern terrain. Colors show its estimated share of each area.

nitrogen-ice.title: LEISA nitrogen ice
nitrogen-ice.summary: Nitrogen-rich ice stands out in Sputnik Planitia. Colors show its estimated share, which depends on the ice model.

water-ice.title: LEISA water ice
water-ice.summary: Water ice underlies Pluto’s more volatile ices. Colors show its surface share estimated from infrared spectra.
